name: Option 4 — Leadership (Moderation Guide)
reference_usage: Visual language shared with /research-plan Option 4 (page geometry, colors, DM Serif Display / DM Sans, section bands, tables) and matched to the approved Meals MVP moderation guide (October 2026): top matter, vertical rhythm, list geometry, inline label styles, and the Session Flow table. The runtime does not require access to any reference document. The document structure is inferred generically (structure-agnostic) and each table's geometry is derived from its complete header.
supported_guide_shapes: Interview / IDI (# Moderation Guide plus study-title, study-period, RACI, and optional Links top matter; Parameter and Consent tables; prose-bullet themes with indented probes; optional Parking Lot)

Prototype / Usability (# Moderation Guide plus study-title, study-period, RACI, and optional Links top matter; Parameter and Phase | Description Session Flow tables; bold-label read/do lists; optional vendor Communication & Deliverables back-matter)

breadcrumb._note: Retained for backward-compatible parsing only (a line above the title or a fully italic top-matter line). The canonical schema has no breadcrumb; the study period line replaces it.

title._note: The first line, '# Moderation Guide', rendered in the TITLE named style.

phase_subtitle._note: The study title. Written as the required '## [Study Title]' line after the title, rendered as a NORMAL_TEXT paragraph (not a heading, not a band), 0/3pt, keep-with-next.

study_period._note: The top-matter line that begins 'Study period:', directly under the study title. 0/16pt, keep-with-next.

heading._note: Inherited research-plan token; intentionally UNUSED in mod-guide. Its structural role is taken by the 14pt section bands.

section_band._note: Applied to every section Heading-2 after the required Study Title top-matter line.

sub_phase_heading._note: Applied to EVERY Heading-3 (e.g. 'Meals Hub', 'Flow 1'); green-on-white so it never reads as a band. 12pt above / 4pt below.

context_note._note: Legacy optional 'Last updated:' line. Not part of the canonical top matter.

links_line.label: Links:
links_line._note: Optional top-matter line '**Links:** [Label](url) · [Label](url)'. Links are black and underlined, never Google blue.

warning._note: Test/demo runs only. The reference guide has no warning block; real-study guides omit it.

structure.role_inference: canonical — first H1 must be 'Moderation Guide'; the immediately following H2 is the study title (rendered NORMAL_TEXT); a top-matter line beginning 'Study period:' is the study period; a top-matter line beginning 'Links:' is the Links line; RACI = consecutive '**Label:** …' bullets; warning = the TEST ARTIFACT paragraph; every later H2 = band; every H3 = sub-phase; every table = Option 4 table styling; every list preserves nesting; all other paragraphs = body.
structure.no_terminal_section: The guide may end anywhere (a table may appear after Post-Session Debrief). The formatter does NOT enforce a terminal section — that content rule lives in SKILL.md / the templates.

section_bands.applies_to: every section ## heading after the required Study Title top-matter line; labels adapt to the study, do not copy an old study's wording

tables.border: Google Docs default; the pipeline sends NO border request (mirrors research-plan's Option 4 pipeline). Settled 2026-10-02 after two live builds verified clean with default borders — do not invent a border value.
tables.column_width_rule: Derive widths from the complete header. Every two-column label/content table, including Parameter | Detail, Cue | Read aloud, and the Phase | Description Session Flow, uses [144, 554.4]. A first header cell of '#' uses [90, remaining]. For 3+ columns, reserve 144pt for the first label column and split the remainder evenly.
tables.label_background_rule: The two-column Parameter | Detail dashboard in top matter gets the gray label column. In-section Consent and Session Flow tables use white cells.
tables.first_column_bold_rule: The first column renders bold when every first cell in the source Markdown is fully bold, as in Parameter | Detail and Cue | Read aloud. Session Flow phase labels stay regular weight.

optional_header_row.note: The Markdown header row is treated as a conversion header and dropped on import (the first content row becomes the first visible row). Header presence is detected per table by row count, so a table may or may not arrive with the header still attached.

session_flow.timing: each phase label ends with its approved minutes, e.g. 'Introduction & Think-Aloud Setup (5 min)'; the minutes sum to the session length

topic_label.rendered_as: body paragraph, whole line bold DM Sans 10; never a heading

checklist_item.rendered_as: ordinary ● bullet whose text starts with '☐ ' (not a native checkbox)

moderator_note.rendered_as: plain body text; no italic, gray, or blockquote treatment

vertical_rhythm.mechanism: explicit empty spacer paragraphs, reconciled by normalize (inserted, removed, or merged) and styled by format
no_spacer: between the title, the study title, and the study period
after a section band (H2), including between the Session Flow band and its table
between items of the same list or RACI block
vertical_rhythm.one_spacer: between every other pair of adjacent block groups: body to list, list to body, body to body, either side of a table, and before the next band
vertical_rhythm.trailing: none after a final paragraph; Google Docs keeps one empty paragraph after a final table
